name: io.github.yixuanzhong/plaxis-mcp
title: PLAXIS
description: Windows-local MCP server for PLAXIS 2D Remote Scripting: geometry, staged construction, results.

packageArguments.name: --role
packageArguments.description: Which PLAXIS endpoint this process serves. A process has one immutable role, so register Input and Output as two separate servers when both are needed. Run `plaxis-mcp setup` once per machine first: it generates the role profiles and stores the PLAXIS passwords in Windows Credential Manager.
